note: Deathskips the guides do not carry. die: where to die (world yards, m 0 Eastern Kingdoms, 1 Kalimdor); graveyard: the world_safe_locs name it gives; filter: who may use it (as in the guides); approx: the place is estimated, check it in game; off: known but the place is not yet known. A skip that dies by a fall names where to jump (die), not where the body lands; the graveyard is the one the landing gives.

skips.name: Menethil Harbor -> Dun Morogh (Kharanos)
skips.how: Swim west of the Theramore boat dock in Menethil Harbor until the subzone text shows Dun Morogh, then drown.
skips.source: community knowledge (Warcraft Tavern, Death Skipping from Kalimdor to Eastern Kingdoms); place estimated

skips.name: Ironforge / Dun Morogh -> Wetlands (Menethil Harbor)
skips.how: Climb the mountains north of Ironforge, jump down towards the Wetlands and die from the fall.
skips.source: RestedXP Forever guides (Guides/Forever/dungeon/Alliance-11-20.lua: the Dun Morogh -> Wetlands deathskip location)

skips.name: The Barrens -> Westfall (Sentinel Hill)
skips.how: From Ratchet run to an unlisted map area (a mountain cleft) in the southern Barrens and die: with no graveyard for the area the Alliance default graveyard, Sentinel Hill, takes the ghost.
skips.source: community knowledge (Warcraft Tavern); the exact place is not published

skips.name: Mulgore -> The Barrens (Crossroads)
skips.how: Run to the eastern mountain ridge of Mulgore north of the Barrens border and jump off the cliff towards the Barrens; the fall is lethal and the ghost rises at the Crossroads.
skips.source: community knowledge; jump point estimated: the ridge cell the walk grid reaches nearest the border at the north end (further south the body lies nearer Camp Taurajo, whose graveyard the server then gives)

skips.name: Mulgore -> The Barrens (Camp Taurajo)
skips.how: Jump off the eastern ridge of southern Mulgore into the Barrens; the ghost rises at Camp Taurajo.
skips.source: community knowledge; jump point estimated: a ridge cell the walk grid reaches at the border
